sql: SELECT p.category, ROUND((SUM(CASE WHEN oi.status NOT IN ('Cancelled', 'Returned') THEN oi.sale_price ELSE 0 END))::numeric, 2) AS net_revenue FROM public.order_items oi JOIN public.inventory_items ii ON ii.id = oi.inventory_item_id JOIN public.products p ON p.id = ii.product_id WHERE oi.created_at >= '2024-01-01' AND oi.created_at < '2025-01-01' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 5

WITH monthly AS (
  SELECT DATE_TRUNC('month', created_at) AS month,
         SUM(CASE WHEN status <> 'Cancelled' THEN sale_price ELSE 0 END) AS gross_revenue
  FROM public.order_items
  WHERE created_at >= '2024-01-01' AND created_at < '2025-01-01'
  GROUP BY 1
)
SELECT to_char(month, 'YYYY-MM') AS month_label,
       ROUND(gross_revenue::numeric, 2) AS gross_revenue,
       ROUND((gross_revenue - LAG(gross_revenue) OVER (ORDER BY month))::numeric, 2) AS mom_increase
FROM monthly
ORDER BY mom_increase DESC NULLS LAST
LIMIT 1

SELECT ROUND((COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN event_type = 'Purchase' THEN session_id END)::double precision / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT session_id), 0))::numeric, 4) AS conversion_rate FROM public.events WHERE created_at >= '2024-01-01' AND created_at < '2025-01-01'

WITH jan_users AS (
  SELECT id, created_at AS user_created_at
  FROM public.users
  WHERE created_at >= '2024-01-01' AND created_at < '2024-02-01'
),
user_orders AS (
  SELECT u.id AS user_id,
         COUNT(DISTINCT oi.order_id) AS non_cancelled_orders
  FROM jan_users u
  JOIN public.order_items oi ON oi.user_id = u.id
  WHERE oi.status <> 'Cancelled'
    AND oi.created_at >= u.user_created_at
    AND oi.created_at < u.user_created_at + INTERVAL '90 days'
  GROUP BY u.id
  HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT oi.order_id) >= 2
)
SELECT ROUND(
  ((SELECT COUNT(*) FROM user_orders)::numeric /
   (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM jan_users)::numeric),
  4
) AS share_of_users

SELECT u.traffic_source, ROUND((SUM(CASE WHEN oi.status <> 'Cancelled' THEN oi.sale_price ELSE 0 END) / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT u.id), 0))::numeric, 2) AS gross_revenue_per_user FROM public.users u LEFT JOIN public.order_items oi ON oi.user_id = u.id AND oi.created_at >= '2024-01-01' AND oi.created_at < '2025-01-01' WHERE u.created_at >= '2024-01-01' AND u.created_at < '2025-01-01' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC

SELECT ROUND((PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (delivered_at - created_at)) / 3600))::numeric, 2) AS median_hours FROM public.order_items WHERE status = 'Complete' AND created_at >= '2024-01-01' AND created_at < '2025-01-01' AND delivered_at IS NOT NULL

SELECT DATE_TRUNC('month', u.created_at) AS acquisition_month,
       COUNT(DISTINCT u.id) AS new_users,
       ROUND((SUM(CASE WHEN oi.status NOT IN ('Cancelled', 'Returned') THEN oi.sale_price ELSE 0 END))::numeric, 2) AS total_net_revenue
FROM public.users u
LEFT JOIN public.order_items oi ON oi.user_id = u.id
    AND oi.created_at >= '2024-01-01' AND oi.created_at < '2025-01-01'
WHERE u.created_at >= '2024-01-01' AND u.created_at < '2025-01-01'
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 1

WITH facebook_users AS (
    SELECT id
    FROM public.users
    WHERE traffic_source = 'Facebook'
      AND created_at >= '2024-01-01'
      AND created_at < '2025-01-01'
),
user_orders AS (
    SELECT 
        oi.user_id,
        oi.order_id,
        MIN(oi.created_at) AS order_date
    FROM public.order_items oi
    JOIN facebook_users fu ON fu.id = oi.user_id
    WHERE oi.status <> 'Cancelled'
    GROUP BY oi.user_id, oi.order_id
),
user_order_ranking AS (
    SELECT 
        user_id,
        order_date,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY user_id ORDER BY order_date) AS order_rank
    FROM user_orders
),
first_second_orders AS (
    SELECT 
        uor1.user_id,
        uor1.order_date AS first_order_date,
        uor2.order_date AS second_order_date,
        EXTRACT(DAY FROM (uor2.order_date - uor1.order_date)) AS days_between
    FROM user_order_ranking uor1
    JOIN user_order_ranking uor2 ON uor1.user_id = uor2.user_id 
        AND uor1.order_rank = 1 
        AND uor2.order_rank = 2
)
SELECT 
    PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY days_between) AS median_days
FROM first_second_orders

WITH user_info AS (
    SELECT 
        id,
        created_at,
        DATE_TRUNC('month', created_at)::date AS reg_month
    FROM public.users
    WHERE created_at >= '2024-01-01' AND created_at < '2025-01-01'
),
user_converted AS (
    SELECT 
        reg_month,
        COUNT(*) AS total_users,
        COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE EXISTS (
            SELECT 1 FROM public.order_items oi 
            WHERE oi.user_id = ui.id 
                AND oi.status <> 'Cancelled'
                AND oi.created_at >= ui.created_at 
                AND oi.created_at < ui.created_at + INTERVAL '30 days'
        )) AS converted_users
    FROM user_info ui
    GROUP BY reg_month
)
SELECT 
    TO_CHAR(reg_month, 'YYYY-MM') AS acquisition_month,
    ROUND((converted_users::double precision / total_users)::numeric, 4) AS share
FROM user_converted
ORDER BY share DESC

WITH fb_users AS (
    SELECT id FROM public.users 
    WHERE traffic_source = 'Facebook' 
    AND created_at >= '2024-01-01' AND created_at < '2025-01-01'
),
user_orders AS (
    SELECT 
        oi.user_id,
        oi.order_id,
        MIN(oi.created_at) AS order_date
    FROM public.order_items oi
    JOIN fb_users u ON u.id = oi.user_id
    WHERE oi.status <> 'Cancelled'
    GROUP BY oi.user_id, oi.order_id
),
ordered_orders AS (
    SELECT 
        user_id,
        order_date,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY user_id ORDER BY order_date) AS rn
    FROM user_orders
),
second_third AS (
    SELECT 
        user_id,
        MAX(CASE WHEN rn = 2 THEN order_date END) AS second_date,
        MAX(CASE WHEN rn = 3 THEN order_date END) AS third_date
    FROM ordered_orders
    WHERE rn <= 3
    GROUP BY user_id
    HAVING COUNT(*) >= 3
)
SELECT 
    PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY EXTRACT(DAY FROM (third_date - second_date))) AS median_days
FROM second_third

WITH user_spend AS (
    SELECT user_id, SUM(sale_price) AS gross_spend
    FROM public.order_items
    WHERE status <> 'Cancelled'
    AND created_at >= '2024-01-01' AND created_at < '2025-01-01'
    GROUP BY user_id
)
SELECT ROUND(PERCENTILE_CONT(0.9) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY gross_spend)::numeric, 2) AS p90_gross_spend
FROM user_spend

WITH organic_users AS (
    SELECT id
    FROM public.users
    WHERE traffic_source = 'Organic'
      AND created_at >= '2024-01-01'
      AND created_at < '2025-01-01'
),
user_orders AS (
    SELECT 
        oi.user_id,
        oi.order_id,
        MIN(oi.created_at) AS order_date
    FROM public.order_items oi
    JOIN organic_users u ON u.id = oi.user_id
    WHERE oi.status <> 'Cancelled'
    GROUP BY oi.user_id, oi.order_id
),
ranked_orders AS (
    SELECT 
        user_id,
        order_date,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY user_id ORDER BY order_date) AS rn
    FROM user_orders
),
first_two AS (
    SELECT 
        user_id,
        MAX(CASE WHEN rn = 1 THEN order_date END) AS first_order_date,
        MAX(CASE WHEN rn = 2 THEN order_date END) AS second_order_date
    FROM ranked_orders
    WHERE rn <= 2
    GROUP BY user_id
    HAVING COUNT(*) = 2
)
SELECT 
    ROUND((EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY (second_order_date - first_order_date))) / 86400)::numeric, 1) AS median_days
FROM first_two

WITH order_values AS (
    SELECT 
        oi.order_id,
        oi.user_id,
        MIN(oi.created_at) AS order_created_at,
        SUM(oi.sale_price) AS order_value
    FROM public.order_items oi
    WHERE oi.created_at >= '2024-01-01' 
      AND oi.created_at < '2025-01-01'
      AND oi.status <> 'Cancelled'
    GROUP BY oi.order_id, oi.user_id
),
user_first_order AS (
    SELECT 
        user_id,
        MIN(order_created_at) AS first_order_time
    FROM order_values
    GROUP BY user_id
),
ordered_orders AS (
    SELECT 
        ov.order_id,
        ov.user_id,
        ov.order_value,
        CASE 
            WHEN ov.order_created_at = ufo.first_order_time THEN 'first'
            ELSE 'repeat'
        END AS order_type
    FROM order_values ov
    JOIN user_first_order ufo ON ov.user_id = ufo.user_id
)
SELECT 
    ROUND((PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY order_value) FILTER (WHERE order_type = 'first'))::numeric, 2) AS first_order_median,
    ROUND((PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY order_value) FILTER (WHERE order_type = 'repeat'))::numeric, 2) AS repeat_order_median,
    ROUND(((PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY order_value) FILTER (WHERE order_type = 'first')) - 
           (PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY order_value) FILTER (WHERE order_type = 'repeat')))::numeric, 2) AS difference
FROM ordered_orders

WITH non_cancelled_orders AS (
    SELECT order_id, user_id, MIN(created_at) AS order_date
    FROM public.order_items
    WHERE status <> 'Cancelled'
      AND created_at >= '2024-01-01' AND created_at < '2025-01-01'
    GROUP BY order_id, user_id
),
user_orders AS (
    SELECT user_id, order_id, order_date,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY user_id ORDER BY order_date) AS order_rank
    FROM non_cancelled_orders
),
first_second AS (
    SELECT u1.user_id,
           u1.order_date AS first_order_date,
           u2.order_date AS second_order_date,
           EXTRACT(DAY FROM (u2.order_date - u1.order_date)) AS days_between
    FROM user_orders u1
    JOIN user_orders u2 ON u1.user_id = u2.user_id AND u2.order_rank = 2
    WHERE u1.order_rank = 1
)
SELECT percentile_cont(0.95) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY days_between) AS p95_days
FROM first_second

WITH search_users AS (
    SELECT id FROM public.users 
    WHERE traffic_source = 'Search' 
    AND created_at >= '2024-01-01' AND created_at < '2025-01-01'
),
user_non_cancelled_orders AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT
        oi.user_id,
        oi.order_id,
        MIN(oi.created_at) AS order_created_at
    FROM public.order_items oi
    JOIN search_users su ON su.id = oi.user_id
    WHERE oi.status <> 'Cancelled'
    GROUP BY oi.user_id, oi.order_id
),
ranked_orders AS (
    SELECT 
        user_id,
        order_id,
        order_created_at,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY user_id ORDER BY order_created_at) AS rn
    FROM user_non_cancelled_orders
),
first_two AS (
    SELECT 
        user_id,
        MAX(CASE WHEN rn = 1 THEN order_created_at END) AS first_order_date,
        MAX(CASE WHEN rn = 2 THEN order_created_at END) AS second_order_date
    FROM ranked_orders
    WHERE rn IN (1, 2)
    GROUP BY user_id
    HAVING COUNT(*) = 2
)
SELECT 
    PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY (second_order_date::date - first_order_date::date)) AS median_days
FROM first_two
